piece.headline: DEEPAK TOPS THE WEEK AS SAKA LEAVES 6 CAPTAINS HIGH AND DRY
piece.standfirst: Deepak topped the week, Saka left 6 captains empty-handed, and Ravin stretched his lead over Rohan to 15 points.
piece.big_picture: Deepak had the best week in the league and climbed to 4th. The big talking point was Saka: 6 managers armed him and got 4 each. Ravin stays top and now leads Rohan by 15. Nikhil is third on a Wildcard.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Rajiv left 29 points on the bench. That is the costliest team selection of the week. Check the XI before the deadline.
piece.one_to_watch: Deepak and Chandru are only 2 points apart at the Gold spots line. If Deepak's Palmer keeps delivering, he could pull clear. A Chandru captain hit could flip it.

winners.name: Prem
winners.verdict: Sole captain of Calafiori. Everyone else looked elsewhere, he backed his hunch, and it returned 18.

winners.name: Poonam
winners.verdict: Biggest climber of the week, up to 15th. Beat the league average comfortably. The bench cost her, so there is still more in there.

losers.name: Vanessa
losers.verdict: Backed Saka with the armband and he blanked. Down 7 places is a heavy fall for one captain call.

losers.name: Rajiv
losers.verdict: Barnes came in and the swap backfired. Then the bench swallowed 29. Brutal week, so let's be kind.

losers.name: Ravi Bhojwani
losers.verdict: Slipped to 24th. No big disaster, just a week that drifted away from him.
